_comment: One verdict per group of sentences that share a FORM and differ in gloss. Recorded from the maintainer's review page, 2026-09-11. `glosses` is the state the verdict was given on and is what apply_same_form_rulings.py matches: it refuses to act on a group whose glosses have moved. `members` is the audit trail of which sentences were on screen - S ids carry a sense number within the page, so they renumber whenever any sense is dropped, and they are deliberately NOT part of the match.

_settled_comment: Verdicts a later rule reproduces on its own. Kept as expectations, not as instructions: apply_same_form_rulings.py checks that each of these groups really has been settled, and says so if one comes back. A rule that stops doing what the maintainer asked for is at minimum worth flagging, and possibly a verdict to restore (maintainer, 2026-09-11).
